title: Japanese Lamb Kebabs
description: A fusion twist on traditional lamb kebabs, marinated in a Japanese-inspired tandoori sauce and grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, garlic, and ginger to make the marinade.
Add the lamb pieces to the marinade and mix to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Thread the marinated lamb onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking. Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the kebabs to a plate and garnish with chopped green onions, if desired.
